newsitem.title: USA: SRS sees Q2 revs flat to Q1 revs.
newsitem.headline: SRS sees Q2 revs flat to Q1 revs.

text.p: SRS Labs expects its revenues for the second quarter to be relatively flat compared to the $2.2 million in revenue reported in the first quarter of 1997.
SRS said second quarter revenues will top revenues in the year-ago quarter. Second quarter earnings will exceed first quarter earnings of $0.07 per share, it said.
Overall, it said second quarter revenue and earnings will fall below analyst forecasts. It said its will release results during the week of July 28, 1997.

"We have experienced delays in available semiconductor solutions for our SRS 3D Sound technology which has slowed our growth into certain markets and entry into other markets," said Steve Sedmak, President of SRS Labs.

"In addition, typically the consumer marketplace experiences a softness in the first calendar quarter following the Christmas selling season and this translates into a softness of revenue for our second quarter of 1997.
A company spokeswoman said analysts were forecasting the company to report earnings in the range of $0.09 to $0.10 per share.
